component.name: LumaMap
component.summary: Projection mapping for walls, pillars and buildings
Videomappning för väggar, pelare och byggnader

description.p: Put video on any surface by dragging its corners until it fits. What you see in the editor is what the projector shows.

ul.li: Quad, triangle, ellipse and curved mesh surfaces
Video files, images, webcams and network streams
Masks with soft edges, blend modes and colour correction
Several projectors with keystone and edge blending
Cues with fades, OSC and MIDI remote control
